name: demo-tools
description: Four arithmetic tools (add, subtract, multiply, divide); divide by zero shows how a tool raises an error the model can read.

interface.shortDescription: Four arithmetic tools and one deliberate tool error.
interface.longDescription: Four arithmetic tools (add, subtract, multiply, divide) implemented with the MCP Python SDK v2. Dividing by zero raises a ToolError instead of crashing, so the model sees a readable failure it can react to.
defaultPrompt: Use demo-tools to divide 10 by 4, then divide 1 by 0.
